summary: Vroom, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its wholly owned subsidiary United Auto Credit Corporation completed a $292,059,710 subprime auto receivables securitization (United Auto Credit Securitization Trust 2026-2) on October 15, 2026, issuing $234,232,000 of asset-backed notes across five classes: Class A $105,012,000 at 5.09%, Class B $41,610,000 at 5.90%, Class C $26,130,000 at 6.36%, Class D $42,210,000 at 7.37%, and Class E $19,270,000 at 9.59%. The filing also references an amendment to an Exchange and Subscription Agreement. This is a routine ABS financing, not a special situation; no deal terms apply. Watch noteholder demand and credit enhancement.
